SELECT 'store' k, CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) b, store_name c, city d, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) f FROM dim_store WHERE city ILIKE '%lahti%' OR store_name ILIKE '%lahti%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prod', category, subcategory, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(distinct sku) AS VARCHAR), '', '' FROM dim_product WHERE category ILIKE '%paint%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%paint%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%interior%' GROUP BY 2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'period', fiscal_year, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR), CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR), '' FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3

SELECT 'multi' k, CAST(p.sku AS VARCHAR) a, p.subcategory b, p.category c, CAST(p.valid_from AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(p.valid_to AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(p.is_current AS VARCHAR) f, p.product_name g
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1 ) AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory='Interior Paint')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(quantity) AS VARCHAR), CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(etl_loaded_at) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.quantity) u, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns nb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT coalesce(f.d,r.d) d, f.u, r.units_sold, f.net, r.nb, f.n FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.d=r.d ORDER BY 1

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, cp.subcategory,
       SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.subcategory = cp.subcategory THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_aswas,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
       MIN(f.quantity) AS minq, COUNT(*) AS lines,
       (SELECT SUM(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f2 ON f2.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f2.store_key JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=f2.product_key JOIN dim_product cp2 ON cp2.sku=p2.sku AND cp2.is_current JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=f2.sale_date WHERE s2.store_id=108 AND cp2.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d2.fiscal_period=3) AS units_returned_later
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
